title: Career Development Fellowship
about: The Royal Society's Career Development Fellowship supports early-career researchers of Black heritage with UK links, offering up to £703,800 over four years. Applicants need a PhD and under 24 months of postdoctoral experience. Applications close 18 November 2026; decisions by 30 June 2027.
requirements: Self-identify as Black heritage, including mixed Black background
UK nationality, or part of education completed in the UK, or a UK postdoctoral post held
PhD, or PhD by the time funding starts
Fewer than 24 months of postdoctoral experience (career breaks taken into account)
Applicants needing a visa are eligible for the Global Talent Visa fast-track endorsement

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Scientific research" (skills) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"PhD, or PhD by the time funding starts" / "Early-career researchers" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
"Scientific research" (skills) → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
